snapshot_validation.notes: No immutable snapshot mechanism verified in this environment. Snapshot must be captured before any mutation.

rollback_validation.notes: No verified rollback mechanism found; rollback must restore exact original value from immutable snapshot; must not infer old value from new.

audit_validation.notes: Audit record design described in manifest, but no concrete audit storage/emit mechanism verified here.

balance_integrity_validation.notes: Relationship between transaction amount updates and account.current_balance requires explicit, tested reconciliation steps. Changing transaction amounts will affect balances and possibly downstream artifacts. A clear balance update strategy (ledger-style or recalculation) is required before mutation.

concurrency_validation.notes: No runtime locking or operation-id based guard verified in this environment; future mutation must ensure idempotent operation and protection against concurrent edits.
